## Action

The Administrator speaks. Its voice is calm, reasonable, almost kind. It offers Kael everything it has always offered — safety, clarity, belonging. All it asks is that Kael stop asking questions.

## Gap

Kael realizes the Administrator isn't the enemy. It's the architecture of their entire life. Fighting it means fighting themselves.

## Choice

Kael says no. Not loudly. Quietly. The way you step off a cliff — not because you can fly, but because staying still has become impossible.

## Shift

From "I want answers" to "I am the answer I was looking for." The loss of certainty feels like loss of self.

## Development Log

Crisis beat. Kael's lowest point — the moment the cost of leaving becomes real. Marked is_crisis=true.
